verdict.rationale: Self-hosting in a replicated, highly available setup is a fair question for a Git forge, but the evidence pack only describes the hosted service at git.cafe. Nothing documents a self-hosted edition, replication, or HA deployment. Branch mirroring to another Git server is a different feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can deploy a self-hosted instance in a replicated, highly available configuration
